training.stage_rule: Independently extend an arm to seeds 3,4 iff any seed 0,1,2 has at least one unchanged-criteria PASS in the balance panel. Evaluate every trained seed on all 160 cases. No retries or evaluation tuning.

inherit_from_v1: Unchanged plant, 10 s timeout, physical limits, causal observation encoding, Q/R, PPO network/learning rate/epochs and remaining hyperparameters, fixed evaluation panel and every acceptance criterion.
reward_definition: 1 - 0.1 * mean over completed 2 ms ticks of post-tick truth quadratic Q cost plus clipped TOTAL issued-command quadratic R cost; subtract 1 on physical termination.
rng_definition: Condition RNG SeedSequence([condition_rng_domain, reset_seed, env_rank]); independent runtime noise seed = noise_seed_base + (policy_seed*n_envs+env_rank)*noise_seed_stride + episode_index. Arms share streams for pairing. Evaluation uses original 1000..1019 directly.
logging: No training trajectories. Optimizer CSV, progress/status JSON, final.zip and vecnormalize.pkl. Evaluation NPZ stores 500 Hz arrays and per-tick sufficient statistics of runtime intervals, never individual integration steps.
